rules.name: resource_budget_mismatch
rules.description: Compare total power, bandwidth, antennas, RF chains, time resources, and training overhead across methods.

rules.name: metric_definition_mismatch
rules.description: Check dB versus linear, fraction versus percentage, MSE versus RMSE, rate versus spectral efficiency, and Pd under different Pfa.

rules.name: missing_sensing_target_model
rules.description: Require target count, range, velocity, angle, RCS, clutter, and noise context when sensing performance is asserted.

rules.name: missing_communication_channel_context
rules.description: Require channel, CSI, modulation, coding, bandwidth, and power context when communication performance is asserted.

rules.name: ideal_self_interference_cancellation
rules.description: Flag perfect self-interference cancellation without residual-interference or sensitivity evidence when applicable.

rules.name: single_joint_weight
rules.description: Flag a single weighted joint objective point without weight sweep, sensitivity analysis, or Pareto evidence.

rules.name: unfair_prior_information
rules.description: Check whether the proposed method receives more perfect CSI, target, location, or environment information than baselines.

rules.name: simulation_over_extrapolation
rules.description: Flag precise deployment claims supported only by ideal simulation or simplified channels.

rules.name: missing_independent_limits
rules.description: Check for communication-only, sensing-only, independent-design, or priority baselines when applicable.

rules.name: near_far_field_mismatch
rules.description: Request review when array aperture, carrier frequency, target range, and propagation model may be inconsistent.

rules.name: insufficient_statistical_evidence
rules.description: Flag conclusions based on a single scene, seed, target position, SNR, or joint weight when broader evidence is required.

rules.name: learning_data_leakage
rules.description: Check temporal, spatial, subject, environment, trajectory, and augmentation leakage across data splits.
